newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Monmouth, N.J..

text.p: SEALEDPROPOSALS will be received by the Director of
Finance of the Board of Chosen Freeholders of the County of Monmouth, New Jersey (the

Records, Finance Department, Third Floor, Freehold, New Jersey, on until 11:00 A.M. at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the County's General Obligation Bonds dated October 15, 1996 and due on October 1, as follows (collectively, the Bonds''):
maturing in the principal amount of $1,350,000 in the
$1,700,000 in the year 2001; $1,800,000 in the year
$2,400,000 in the year 2008; $2,500,000 in the year
Individual purchases of beneficial ownership interest in the Bonds will be made in book-entry form (without

certificates) in the denomination of $5,000 each or any integral multiple thereof. The Bonds will bear interest at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on April 1, 1997 and semiannually thereafter on October 1 and April 1 in each year until maturity. The Bonds maturing on or after October 1, 2006 are subject to redemption at the option of the County in accordance with the Notice of Sale dated October 16, 1996 (the Notice of Sale
will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost in accordance with the terms of the Notice of Sale.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale, the Proposal for Bonds and the form of the legal opinion of Crummy, Del Deo, Dolan, Griffinger & Vecchione, a Professional Corporation, Newark, New Jersey, bond counsel to the County, may be obtained from the Director of Finance of the County at the Hall of Records, Finance Department, Third Floor, Freehold, New Jersey 07728-1256 (telephone (908) 431-7391), or from the County's financial advisor, Public Resources Advisory Group, 40 Rector Street, New York, New York 10006 (telephone (212) 566-7800). Dated October 16, 1996
